For the right focus and right directrix,
\[
d(P,\text{right focus}) = e \cdot d(P,\text{right directrix}).
\]
Given \(d(P,\text{right focus})=26\) and \(e=\frac{13}{5}\),
\[
26 = \frac{13}{5} \cdot d(P,\text{right directrix}),
\]
so
\[
d(P,\text{right directrix}) = 26 \cdot \frac{5}{13} = 10.
\]

\boxed{10}
